name: @trek/root

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!/^pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('This repo uses pnpm (pinned via packageManager). Run: corepack enable && pnpm install'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run build && concurrently --names shared,server,client "pnpm --filter @trek/shared run build:watch" "pnpm --filter @trek/server run dev" "pnpm --filter @trek/client run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run build && pnpm --filter @trek/server run build && pnpm --filter @trek/client run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run test && pnpm --filter @trek/server run test && pnpm --filter @trek/client run test
scripts.test:cov: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @trek/server run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @trek/client run test:coverage && pnpm -C plugin-sdk run test:coverage
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run lint && pnpm --filter @trek/server run lint && pnpm --filter @trek/client run lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run format && pnpm --filter @trek/server run format && pnpm --filter @trek/client run format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @trek/shared run format:check && pnpm --filter @trek/server run format:check && pnpm --filter @trek/client run format:check

comment:scarfSettings: swagger-ui-dist ships @scarf/scarf install-time analytics; TREK sends no telemetry, so it stays off.
comment:pnpm.overrides: pnpm equivalent of npm overrides (pnpm ignores npm's `overrides` field). Force a single React 19 across the workspace so the test renderer (@testing-library/react) and the app share one react-dom; the rest pins transitive deps the server relies on (migrated from server's npm overrides).
comment:optionalDependencies: pnpm already records every platform's optional deps in pnpm-lock.yaml (including the musl builds the Alpine image needs), so these pins are belt-and-braces: they keep the exact binary versions of client's sharp / rollup present at the top of the hoisted tree. Keep them in lockstep with those packages or drop them entirely — a mismatch nests the binary away from libvips.
